label: Synthetic: real code, no proof
title: Possible length issue in Curl_cookie_add() with very long cookie names
body: Tested on curl 8.23.0. While reading lib/cookie.c I noticed that Curl_cookie_add() parses the name and value of a Set-Cookie header. I suspect that very long names could cause problems, but I have not been able to trigger anything yet. Could you take a look?
